'''2008 Worlds Day 2 Matt Sherrington LS Hidden Base''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Matt Sherrington]] at [[2008 World Championship]] (Day 2). Sheet title ROLLON ROLLS. Naboo Defense Fighter swarm Hidden Base.


== Deck info ==

* '''Player:''' [[Matt Sherrington]]
* '''Event:''' [[2008 World Championship]]
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Original VS16]]
* '''Side:''' [[Light]]
* '''Starting Card:''' [[Hidden Base / Systems Will Slip Through Your Fingers|Hidden Base]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 2
